headline: Divided Fronts See Fresh Strategic Movement
war_summary: The latest returns show the campaign’s pressure concentrated on a handful of divided or recently contested sectors. Weathered Expanse has become the busiest ledger, rising to 64 base events in 24 hours and nine in the latest two-hour window; its holdings now read six Colonial, one Warden, and two neutral. Palantine Berm follows with 54 daily events and five recent, while retaining five Warden, one Colonial, and one neutral base. Stlican Shelf records 24 events, including one recent, and stands at eight Colonial and one Warden holding. Stonecradle has quickened to 11 daily events and three recent, with eight Colonial bases and one Warden. Callahan’s Passage remains a costly furnace—33 events in the day and two recent—with nine Warden bases and one neutral. Kuura Strand has also seen 11 daily events, though none in the latest two hours, and remains entirely Warden-held. Several other fronts, including Nevish Line, Dead Lands, and Clahstra, have gone quiet in base terms despite substantial casualty records; the immediate ownership picture is therefore being shaped chiefly by the active sectors above.
